comparison.objective: Align an occluded passive slider index to an internal target through an inspection opening.
comparison.physical_skill: Visually guided fine slider adjustment under occlusion while avoiding fixture contact.
comparison.success_condition: Body reports released, still alignment and demo error below 0.625 mm, but no complete numeric scoring rubric/spec is supplied.
comparison.reason: Tests perception and fine positional alignment of a slider; it lacks tool-mediated impact, fracture and detached-part recovery.
